summary: Add missing test coverage for the shipped §5 revert-note write (FRICTION-REVERT-NOTE shipped src-only)

per.section: 5. Revert note — the operator's copy of the verdict

edit.description: Cover writeRevertNote (src/Dispatcher.ts ~1451-1520, called from runFanoutEntry's afterCommit revert branch ~1033-1039) e2e via dispatcher.tick(): an entry-scope afterCommit revert with Chain.friction declared leaves a dated --tag--reverted.md note in the primary friction dir carrying the gate name/message/details (include a write-gate case so details carries the offending path list, per §5) and the reverted commit's subject+body; undeclared chain.friction is a no-op; a note-write failure (e.g. unwritable friction dir) logs and does not block the revert.

tests.asserts: an afterCommit gate revert with Chain.friction declared leaves a reverted.md note with the gate's name/message/details (incl. write-gate offending-path-list case) and the reverted commit's subject+body; undeclared chain.friction is a no-op; a note-write failure logs and the revert still proceeds.

acceptance: tests/Dispatcher.test.ts asserts §5's revert-note write; FRICTION-REVERT-NOTE (b128717) ships with committed coverage instead of none.
notes: Same defect shape as FRICTION-DECLARATION-TESTS/FRICTION-GITIGNORE-TESTS/TEARDOWN-HARDENING-TESTS: entry named tests[] but files.edit was src-only, so the writablePaths guard forced a src-only build (per the build commit's own body). Fourth recurrence — all four v0.6.2 sections were derived in one batch (443aa1a) sharing the same authoring gap.

summary: Surface friction counts on status/loop/job-status and switch job extract off the legacy friction.md guess per §6

edit.description: flume status (~630-635) and flume job status (~343-369): append a friction count line when declared and non-empty, per §6.

jobStatus: expose friction count for cli.ts's job-status line. jobExtract (~727-736): when declared, read the friction dir off the job's working tree (fs, not git show — gitignored content was never committed) and print path+content per file, replacing the legacy hardcoded friction.md guess; undeclared keeps today's harvestPaths behavior exactly.
superviseLoop's end-of-run summary: append the same friction count line per §6.

tests.asserts: status and job-status print a friction count line when declared+non-empty, omit it otherwise.
job extract prints the declared friction dir's files (path+content) instead of the legacy friction.md guess; an undeclared chain's extract output is unchanged.

acceptance: status, job status, and loop-end summaries print `friction: N note(s) await routing` when Chain.friction is declared and non-empty; job extract prints the declared dir's files instead of guessing friction.md; undeclared chains are byte-for-byte unchanged.
notes: Friction is gitignored by design (operator ruling, a326c1c) — job extract must read it from the working tree, not git history; the existing harvestPaths loop uses git show and cannot see it.
